comment:
* Represent the Key Usage Extension. * *

This extension, if present, defines the purpose (e.g., encipherment, * signature, certificate signing) of the key contained in the certificate. * The usage restriction might be employed when a multipurpose key is to be * restricted (e.g., when an RSA key should be used only for signing or only * for key encipherment). * * @author Amit Kapoor * @author Hemma Prafullchandra * @see Extension * @see CertAttrSet
